## What to build

Role contracts, ADRs, GLOSSARY and future notes agree with the revised specs. [Fixture trim: the rest of this paragraph restated the merge rule check-owned-rules reserves for spec #gates-merge; dropped, the tickets check does not read it. comms#acceptance-close-report-first (both mentions) replaced by comms#acceptance-close-message: gh1075's weakens call removed that criterion (docs/specs/comms.calls.jsonl), and this fixture's ids must exist in the kit specs. Every other line is verbatim from `gh issue view 10 --json body`, 2026-10-20.]

Spec: docs/specs/issue-lifecycle.spec.html#lc-merge, #gates-merge, #acceptance-merge-approved-head, #acceptance-merge-head-moved; docs/specs/comms.spec.html#transport-close-space, #acceptance-close-message.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] issue-lifecycle#gates-merge: agents/supervisor.md names the head-pinned merge command and the moved-head rule; its /goal, self-check, lane close and Never list agree
- [ ] issue-lifecycle#lc-merge: agents/director.md relays the yes with the head for merges (promotion and traffic shift unchanged), no longer calls integrate the merge, checks main CI after
- [ ] comms#acceptance-close-message: supervisor close reports before its own worktree is removed; director teardown removes it
- [ ] no ADR or GLOSSARY line says otherwise (corrected in place); docs/future.md Landing agent entry
- [ ] demo: just check green (refs, dashes, roles)

## Blocked by

None (can start immediately)
